guides.title: Ollama Chat Provider · Connection
guides.description: Use Connection in Ollama Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Verify the local Ollama server
steps.body: Open Connection and confirm the server URL points at your running Ollama service. A model list should appear only after the server responds. This backend’s page does not document a dedicated test button; a listed entry after a refresh is the visible sign the server answered, not a generation test.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Recover a missing model list
steps.body: If the selector stays empty, confirm Ollama is running, the URL is correct, and any required local model has been pulled in Ollama itself. A successful link without models means download or name state, not a broken NC addon. Refresh or reconnect before editing generation values.

guides.title: Ollama Chat Provider · Model
guides.description: Use Model in Ollama Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Choose one available model
steps.body: In Model pick a name from the listed entries, then confirm the selector still shows it when you return. A name in the list means the server reported it; it does not prove a reply. After choosing, use a harmless Main Chat ask to confirm generation.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Distinguish availability from readiness
steps.body: The model selector lists what Ollama reports; readiness depends on a real reply. If generation fails while the name remains listed, check the Ollama server logs and local resources before choosing a different tag. Keep the working selection noted so you can restore it.

guides.title: Ollama Chat Provider · Generation
guides.description: Use Generation in Ollama Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.
learning_outcomes: Record changes so they can be reversed

steps.title: Inspect generation values before comparison
steps.body: Keep the existing generation values while learning their purpose. A later short reply with the same prompt and active model gives a useful comparison after one deliberate edit. Connection failures and missing models must be resolved separately; the related guides identify those areas without changing sampling values.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Record changes so they can be reversed
steps.body: Note values before editing, then compare the next reply with the previous one rather than assuming a slider guarantees a quality change. If the output worsens, restore the recorded value. Generation tuning assumes a confirmed server and listed model.
